##### Project general facts

Azoria Living is a visionary development by Coco Development Group, a seasoned developer with nearly a decade of experience creating lifestyle-driven assets across Bali. Located in the prestigious Uluwatu area, this branded residential project redefines tropical living by seamlessly blending adventure and tranquility. Designed for those who want it all, the development offers expertly crafted properties that serve as both a serene personal sanctuary and a high-performance investment asset.

Azoria Living sets a new standard for resort-style living with an extraordinary array of amenities. The development features six professional padel courts and the largest gym in Uluwatu, catering to fitness enthusiasts. Wellness zones, a podcast studio, a co-working space, a restaurant, and three beach-inspired pools complete this exceptional offering. Every element is designed to create a vibrant community where residents can work, play, and recharge without ever leaving the property.

Each residence at Azoria Living is crafted with opulent finishes and premium materials, reflecting a commitment to timeless elegance. From the cozy Cabana to the spacious Imperio villa with a private pool, every unit features a fully equipped kitchen, inviting living spaces, and thoughtful layouts that maximize comfort. The design philosophy blends innovative technology, sustainable practices, and authentic Balinese craftsmanship, creating homes that are as beautiful as they are functional.

##### Parking

Shared parking. 

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Uluwatu, this exceptional location places residents just moments from some of Bali's most stunning and photographed coastlines. Uluwatu is renowned as the island's most sought-after area, offering the highest rental yields and unparalleled natural beauty. The surrounding landscape features dramatic cliffs, world-class surf breaks, and pristine white-sand beaches that attract discerning travelers from across the globe.

The area is distinguished by its vibrant yet serene atmosphere, where iconic beach clubs, renowned temples, and trendy dining establishments coexist with tranquil coastal escapes. Residents enjoy close proximity to hidden gems such as Nunggalan Beach, as well as famous destinations like Savaya, El Kabron, and Uluwatu Temple. The neighborhood perfectly balances seclusion with accessibility, offering a peaceful retreat that remains connected to Bali's cultural and social heart.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both adventure and relaxation, Uluwatu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its dramatic sunsets, consistent surf, and growing reputation as a wellness and hospitality hub have made it one of the world's most desirable destinations. This is a place where luxury, nature, and community converge, an ideal setting for investors and homeowners alike.
